feedTitle: Weather forecast for the Isle of Man

items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 2 May 2026 12:12pm
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Saturday, 02 May 2026 at 11:50am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

Largely cloudy and mainly dry this afternoon, before outbreaks of rain develop this evening. Light south or southwest wind and a maximum temperature of 13°C. There'll be fairly persistent rain overnight.

Cloudy tomorrow with further outbreaks of rain during the morning, this tending to gradually peter out in the afternoon with bright or sunny intervals developing. Light to moderate north or northeast wind and a top temperature of 15°C.


##Outlook##

Mainly dry with bright or sunny spells on Monday. Light to moderate north or northwest wind and a highest temperature of 14°C.

5:38am Tomorrow
